crossRefs.note: In that day, people will look to their Maker, and their eyes will have respect for the Holy One of Israel.
They will not look to the altars, the work of their hands; neither shall they respect that which their fingers have…
Those of you that escape will remember me among the nations where they are carried captive, how I have been broken with…
I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean. I will cleanse you from all your filthiness, and from all…
They won’t defile themselves any more with their idols, nor with their detestable things, nor with any of their…
It will be in that day,” says Yahweh, “that you will call me ‘my husband,’ and no longer call me ‘my master.’
For I will take away the names of the Baals out of her mouth, and they will no longer be mentioned by name.
Assyria can’t save us. We won’t ride on horses; neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, ‘Our gods!’ for…
Ephraim, what have I to do any more with idols? I answer, and will take care of him. I am like a green cypress tree…
Their land also is full of idols. They worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made.

translations.web: I will cut off your engraved images and your pillars out from among you; and you shall no more worship the work of your hands.
translations.bsb: I will also cut off the carved images and sacred pillars from among you, so that you will no longer bow down to the work of your own hands.
translations.kjv: Thy graven images also will I cut off, and thy standing images out of the midst of thee; and thou shalt no more worship the work of thine hands.
translations.asv: and I will cut off thy graven images and thy pillars out of the midst of thee; and thou shalt no more worship the work of thy hands;
